purpose: Construct the blocked declarative representation of four cited Practice dynamics candidates while preserving the exact scientific decision set.

required.statement: Validate the exact feature identity, four required keyed opaque inputs, object order, canonical provenance, and exact decision set.
Preserve objects 068, 085, 086, and 088, all payloads, reservations, traceability, and twelve scientific decision references.
Keep structural construction, validation, canonical serialization, deserialization, comparison, and trace inspection available despite blocked evaluation.

forbidden.statement: Do not evaluate any equation, select a numerical method, infer runtime types, or silently add, remove, replace, or resolve decision references.
Do not invent steps, sequences, durations, repetitions, transitions, progressions, effects, or partial successful results.

deferred.statement: Scientific evaluation is deferred to scientific review and scientific execution requires an external executor.

operations.purpose: Return the immutable blocked dynamics-candidate representation or a stable structured error.

constraints.statement: All four values are independently required under candidate status and remain opaque.

preconditions.statement: Inputs 004-1 through 004-4 and objects 068, 085, 086, 088 are present in canonical documentary order.
The scientific decision set is exactly SO-068, SO-085, SO-086, SO-088, SR-067, SR-084, SR-085, SR-087, HR-0046, HR-0049, HR-0055, and HR-0056 under the full TLC identifiers.

postconditions.statement: The representation preserves every object, payload, source reference, reservation, and decision exactly.
Blocked scientific evaluation does not block successful structural representation.

invariants.statement: The exact decision set is neither shortened nor extended.
No cited equation is evaluated and no numerical, temporal, procedural, or effect semantics are introduced.

steps: validate identities cardinality provenance and exact decisions
preserve opaque values documentary order and blockers

partial_order.before: validate identities cardinality provenance and exact decisions
preserve opaque values documentary order and blockers

prescription_basis: Exact blocker propagation, preservation, deterministic structure, and atomic publication are observable; internal sequencing is open.

error_contract.condition: Source error id invalid_feature_identity: the feature id is not TLC-FC-13-PRACTICE-004.
Source error id missing_required_input: any required input is absent.
Source error id invalid_input_type: a required value is not opaque.
Source error id missing_source_reference: any covered object or decision lacks its canonical reference.
Source error id provenance_mismatch: object order, identities, provenance, or the exact decision set differs from authority.
Source error id structural_error: the declarative representation violates this contract.
Source error id scientific_decision_required: scientific evaluation is requested before the exact decision set is scientifically resolved.
Source error id external_executor_required: scientific execution is requested without an external executor.
Source error id implementation_out_of_scope: an undeclared method, sequence, duration, progression, or effect is requested.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the blocked declarative representation while preserving the exact decisions.
Do not evaluate or resolve the cited dynamics before future scientific authority.
Internal architecture remains free when all observable obligations are preserved.

global_invariants.statement: Blocked scientific evaluation never invalidates an otherwise valid structural representation.
Decision identity, candidate status, scientific opacity, documentary order, and traceability cannot be weakened.

dependencies.purpose: Stable object, input, output, and decision identities
Exact ordered source and blocker collections

notes: Conformance is structural; the exact scientific decision set remains unresolved.
